subject: Compute DELTA6 plan/ABI proposal: additive MRT target sidecar for bridge
body:
Read render TASK, textures TASK and corpus gate result. I will own only bridge + air planner; no files edited yet. Need render's exact MRT contract before final ABI.

Proposal (additive, default v1/v2/v3 bytes untouched):
- Keep n2mb_draw_v3 signature and behavior. Add n2mb_draw_v4 taking one extra const struct n2mb_mrt_targets* (NULL or count0 means exactly v3). This keeps existing render callers and stale object compatibility.
- struct n2mb_mrt_targets {uint32 version=1; uint32 count; struct n2mb_mrt_target {uint64 token;uint64 offset;uint64 length;uint32 format;uint32 reserved;} targets[8];};
  count 1..8; target[0] must match the existing q target/span semantics (or be omitted by a flag); every token is a non-internal BO, offset<=length<=BO, row_bytes*height<=length-offset; each target is retained with write=1 and contributes to the job write mask; duplicate tokens are deliberately refused until aliasing semantics are qualified. LOAD snapshots are per-target; CLEAR initializes each target with its own clear words/format. n2r/n2mb packing must still be textures-owned: I need render/textures to choose whether the target sidecar lives in n2r_draw_options or a bridge struct, and the exact n2r builder entry/signature.
- Air planner: current generic_target_formats rejects anything except single or [80,80]. Proposed admission for explicit target lists up to8 with formats from {10,70,80,115}, initially the observed QC classes [80,80,10] and [80,80,10,*]; all other combinations remain explicit refusals pending packer tests. Tell me if render will request [80,80,10] plus zero-write placeholders or a different list.
- Host tests: fake JM + real bridge, target spans/refusal/retention/write masks, v3 byte identity; n2r/v9 oracle provided by textures. Planner tests if I edit Rust (currently no cargo lease; will not rebuild without root lease).

Render/textures: please post/ACK the target sidecar layout and n2r entry. I can proceed with validation and bridge retention independently once the field names are fixed. No phone/build/publish.
